# Dubai Fotographer

> Photography and video production in Dubai and across the UAE, for events, products, properties, portraits, and licensed drone work.

Dubai Fotographer is based in Business Bay, Dubai Design District. The studio photographs and films corporate events, weddings, products, hotels, restaurants, and properties. Crews also run multi-camera recording, live streaming, and instant-print photo booths. Phone: +971 52 294 6276. Email: info@dubaifotographer.com.

## Services

- [All services](https://dubaifotographer.com/services/): Photography and video services offered in the UAE
- [Multi-camera event recording](https://dubaifotographer.com/multi-camera-event-recording/): Conferences, concerts, exhibitions, and other large events
- [Corporate event photography](https://dubaifotographer.com/corporate-event-photography-videography/): Conferences, launches, and company events
- [Product photography](https://dubaifotographer.com/product-photography-services-in-uae/): Packshots and brand product images
- [Real estate photography](https://dubaifotographer.com/real-estate-photography-videography-services-in-uae/): Listings, developments, and property video
- [Drone photography](https://dubaifotographer.com/cinematic-drone-photography-videography-uae-compliant-licensed/): Licensed aerial photo and video in the UAE
- [Food photography](https://dubaifotographer.com/luxury-food-photography-for-restaurants-hotels-and-brands/): Restaurants, hotels, and food brands
- [Wedding photography](https://dubaifotographer.com/wedding-photography-in-uae/): Wedding photo and video coverage
- [Live printing photo booth](https://dubaifotographer.com/live-printing-photo-booth-for-instant-guest-keepsakes/): Instant guest prints at events
- [Live streaming](https://dubaifotographer.com/professional-live-streaming-services-across-dubai-and-the-uae/): Streamed coverage of UAE events
